concept.hr: Trapovi daju istoj žici različite električne duljine na različitim pojasevima
concept.en: Traps give one wire different electrical lengths on different bands

summary.hr: Na rezonantnoj frekvenciji trapovi blokiraju i radi samo unutarnji dio; ispod nje produljuju zračitelj, iznad nje ga skraćuju.
summary.en: At their resonant frequency the traps block and only the inner part works; below it they lengthen the radiator, above it they shorten it.

what.hr: Aplet applet_traps.html (djelotvorna duljina trap-dipola na tri frekvencije) i njegove slike 235, 1135 i 1136 (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_traps.html (the effective length of a trap dipole at three frequencies) and its figures 235, 1135 and 1136 (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

credits.by: 50ohm.de-Autorenteam, AJW-Referat des DARC e.V. (figures: Prof. Dr. Matthias Jung, DL9MJ)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, slike ponovno nacrtane kao SVG, tekst preveden na engleski, gumbi postali koraci i predlošci, dodani krivulja reaktancije trapa, pregled promjena i objašnjenje
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, the figures redrawn as SVG, the text translated into English, the buttons turned into steps and presets, a trap reactance curve, a summary of what changed and an explanation added
